uncertain: Right connector 3 is roughly level with the USB-C connector: its bottom pin (IN+) was judged closest to USB, but the distance difference to its top pin is small
notes: Power screw terminal (DC 5-12V) has no individually labeled pins and is skipped. Reset/Boot buttons, antenna connectors and switch skipped. Group A-D HIGH/LOW dot legends (27/14/26/25) are a level table, not pin positions. HX711 and SX1262 IO lists are internal signal assignments with no pads shown.
